rows.en: I can't put up with you anymore. If you'll excuse me.
I'm somehow just exhausted... from supporting you.
rows.notes: Inverted Japanese order kept: tiredness first, then "your support".

rows.en: Was I able to support you properly?
Congratulations. I'm so glad it was a success.
Looks like you made it back safely. What a relief.
With your skills, success is only natural.
Watching you work was simply breathtaking.
rows.notes: horebore suru: admiring.

rows.en: I've kind of worked up a sweat. Shall we go take a shower together?
rows.notes: 360-371 are the female-partner result lines.

rows.en: Would you wear some clothes I designed?
I'm just so happy I get to support you!
Um, could I draw a picture of you sometime?
Not bad at all!
That's only to be expected.
rows.notes: Praise line (200-201); kept neutral about whose skill is meant.

rows.en: I'll move in to back you up.
rows.notes: Ozma uses polite form in 210-217 (addressing a stranger or superior).

rows.en: Please fall back and regroup.
It's dangerous! Please fall back!
No! Shot down, just like that!?
rows.notes: Who was shot down is not said (listener or an ally); kept impersonal.

rows.en: This has to be a joke...
To think it would end like this...
Impressive.
Seems your skills haven't dulled one bit.
I'm counting on you, Canaria.
All units, don't fall behind!
Who the hell are you!? What happened to Gilliam!?
rows.notes: Gilliam = Henry Gilliam (Skull Squadron), Ozma context.

rows.en: Ranka! Are you okay!?
rows.notes: Transcript has "buji ka" in katakana; reading is clear.

rows.en: Thank goodness.
All units, charge! Totsugeki Love Heart!
rows.notes: Pun on totsugeki (charge) and the Fire Bomber song "Totsugeki Love Heart" (glossary); Ozma is a Fire Bomber fan.
Grunt (ku).

rows.en: Sheryl! Leave this to me! So sing your heart out!
rows.notes: Transcript "utare" (be shot) is surely "utae" (sing).

rows.en: Way to go!
Amazing, amazing! That's amazing!
Um, are you okay?
Please hang in there!
It's going to get dangerous at this rate!
No way, shot down!?
rows.notes: Who was shot down is not said; kept impersonal.

rows.en: I can't believe this is happening!
Please eject, quickly!
Impressive, as always!
That was so cool!
Yay!
No, stay away!
B-Big brother?
rows.notes: As MUF renders Ranka's "oniichan".

rows.en: Alto!
rows.notes: Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Yes!
Also, the number of combo hits changes with the pilot's melee stat.
rows.notes: Training voice; terms as the in-game tutorial text (u3647).

rows.en: Of course, the higher the stat, the more melee attacks you can chain!
That covers the basic Special Maneuver controls.
Target area reached. That ends the Special Maneuvers training.
Training time is up. That ends the Special Maneuvers training.
...and Ranka Lee will walk you through the controls together!
rows.notes: Second half of Sheryl 1104 "From here on, Sheryl Nome..."; cut at the same point.

rows.en: Um, so we're explaining Special Maneuvers 3, right?
Um, so we're explaining the Special Maneuvers, right?
Being able to lock on to enemy aces right away is a great feature!
Next up is the Anti-Missile Action.
Idiot!
rows.notes: Bare "baka!" in the tutorial banter; target unclear (probably Sheryl).

rows.en: Last up: the newly added controls and the ones that changed.
Let's save the galaxy with our explanations, Sheryl!
rows.notes: Answered by Sheryl 1109.

rows.en: But I want to explain!
Yes, Sheryl!
With SP Gauge to spare, hold the L button and mash the Triangle button to use Charge Guard.
rows.notes: "Charge Guard" (chaaji gaado) is not in the glossary; looks like an alternate take of 1116 (Charge Break). Says renda (mash) and L only, unlike the final L+R command.

rows.en: With SP Gauge to spare, hold the L button and mash the Triangle button to use Charge Break.
rows.notes: Says renda (mash) and L only; the in-game text says L+R and press.

rows.en: It's the same command as Charge Melee in the earlier games. Charge Melee is gone this time.
While it's active you can't boost or use any attacks, so be careful.
So knowing when to use it is key.
Of course, if you're not holding the L button, you can still multi-lock-on.
For taking on a crowd of enemies at once, multi-lock-on...
rows.notes: Sentence continues in Sheryl 1121 (Single Lock for one target).

rows.en: Finally, I'll explain Plus Lock.
With missile-type special weapons that fire when you release the button, lock on to the target, then keep holding Circle for an attack power bonus.
Aim really carefully and the power goes up! Use it a lot, okay?
That wraps up all the controls, right, Sheryl?
Sheryl?
Training ends when you reach the target area or time runs out.
Target area reached. That ends the New Special Maneuvers training.
Training time is up. That ends the New Special Maneuvers training.
See? You can do it when you try.
Keep it up like this.
I need you to pull yourself together.
This is getting dangerous.
I can't count on you at all, can I?
You're kidding! Shot down!?
rows.notes: Who was shot down is not said; kept impersonal.
